details.report:
Implemented issue #17 package/documentation closure.

- Migrated installed-tarball Reviewer lifecycle to exact task bytes + mandatory V1 capability file, native Skill expansion, rejected-proposal correction, one irreversible established-Spec dispatch/two legs, prompt hashes, audit revise/pass, termination, and target preservation.
- Migrated subprocess fatal-stage fixtures to structured proposals and capability files; print/JSON paths prove abort, exact provider-call cardinality, and no accepted receipt.
- Updated README with CLI shape, closed vocabulary/schema, byte-exact bash grants, fail-closed narrowing, atomic proposal semantics, two-leg/Standards-only behavior, prompt/audit evidence, and unchanged topology/model/security disclaimers.
- Removed issue-17 skips and obsolete arbitrary Agent fixture shape. Souls/Receipts/Recorder/package distribution were unchanged.

TDD evidence: the migrated focused tests initially failed on the old proposal shape/missing capability and canonical Skill fixture, then passed after fixture/package lifecycle construction. Focused Reviewer + fatal subprocess suite: 33/33 passing, no skips/todos.

Behavior-fact check: installed tarball independently loads the package, binds exact task/capability bytes, rejects widening before start, accepts one two-leg dispatch, records exact prompt digests/target, audits correction then accepts the thin receipt. Fatal subprocess matrix passes for print and JSON.
Same-pattern check: `rg` finds no Reviewer `subagent_type`, issue-17 `test.skip`/`test.todo`, same-message provenance, or fake-Spec remnants in active docs/tests/source.
Introduced-regression check: typecheck passed; isolated-HOME full suite reached 337/338 passing with zero skips/todos. The sole failure was pre-existing Recorder lifecycle test `install over stale/foreign binding rebuilds a host-loadable module`, where its nested npm install failed with external `ECONNRESET`; all Reviewer tests passed in that same run. `npm pack --dry-run` passed (64 files), and `git diff --check` passed.
